description: This file contains unit tests for the PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks class, verifying its behavior in checking resource limits such as connections and data volume, using mock dependencies and validating responses and cache interactions.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecksTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks behaviors, including limit checks, data volume calculations, cache interactions, and response handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and configures the PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks instance before each test.

methods.name: testConnectionLimitIsNotReached
methods.description: Verifies that the connection limit check returns false when current connections are below the max.

methods.name: testConnectionLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies that the connection limit check returns true when current connections reach the max.

methods.name: testMessageLimitNotExceeded
methods.description: Checks that the message limit is not exceeded when usage is below the threshold.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceeded
methods.description: Checks that the message limit is exceeded when usage surpasses the threshold.

methods.name: testCalculateDataVolume
methods.description: Validates data volume calculations over different periods and modes.

methods.name: testCalculateDataUsagePeriod
methods.description: Validates calculation of data usage period in months and days modes.

methods.name: testMessageLimitNotExceededWhenNotConfigured
methods.description: Ensures no web client calls are made when message limits are not set.

methods.name: testMessageLimitUsesValueFromCache
methods.description: Checks that data volume usage values are retrieved from the cache.

methods.name: testMessageLimitStoresValueToCache
methods.description: Verifies that metrics data retrieved from Prometheus is stored in cache for future use.

methods.name: givenCurrentConnections
methods.description: Helper method to mock current connection count response from Prometheus.

methods.name: givenDataVolumeUsageInBytes
methods.description: Helper method to mock data volume usage response from Prometheus.
